keyword: electric 10 or electric 15 concrete pump order

title.en: Ordering Electric 10 Series or Electric 15 from Xingtai
title.zh: 向邢台订电动10系列还是电动15

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 10 Series at 21 m³/h and 25 m horizontal, and Electric 15 at 8–10 m³/h with both a vertical and a horizontal range. Both list 15 kW. They are different orders.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列印成 21 m³/h、水平 25 m，把电动15印成 8–10 m³/h，并同时有垂直和水平范围。两者都写 15 kW。订单不是同一张。

h1.en: Electric 10 Series and Electric 15 Are Not the Same 15 kW Order
h1.zh: 电动10系列和电动15不是同一张 15 kW 订单

directAnswer.en: Both compact electric pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai print 15 kW, and then they diverge. Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, horizontal 25 m only, aggregate 2 cm and below, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg. It does not print pressure or hopper. Send the path that matches the cells you can accept.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）的两张紧凑电动页都印 15 kW，然后就分开了。电动10系列印 21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、只有水平 25 m、骨料 2 cm 及以下、1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。电动15印 8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg。它不印压力，也不印料斗。发送你能接受其格子的那条路径。

heading.en: Do not upgrade 10 into 15 by the name
heading.zh: 不要按名称把 10 升级成 15

body.en: The “10” page prints the higher output, 21 m³/h, and the shorter distance, 25 m horizontal with no vertical cell. The “15” page prints 8–10 m³/h and a longer horizontal range. Buying the higher numeral does not buy the higher output.
body.zh: “10”这一页印出更高的输送量 21 m³/h，以及更短的距离：水平 25 m，没有垂直格。 “15”这一页印 8–10 m³/h 和更长的水平范围。买更大的数字不等于买更高的输送量。

body.en: No outlet pressure and no hopper volume appear on the Electric 15 specification list. Do not copy 23 MPa or 0.1 m³ from Electric 10 Series onto it. Pipe diameter 100–125 mm is printed only on Electric 15 in this pair.
body.zh: 电动15的规格列表上没有出口压力，也没有料斗容积。不要把电动10系列的 23 MPa 或 0.1 m³ 抄过去。这一对里，管径 100–125 mm 只印在电动15上。

body.en: One note may say you are choosing between the two slugs. Ask Hebei Pinjin Machinery which path to quote only after you add stone size, measured metres and site voltage and frequency. Price is on [/en/contact/](/en/contact/), not on the sheets.
body.zh: 一封信可以写你正在两条路径之间选择。请先加上石子粒径、量到的米数以及现场电压和频率，再请河北品锦机械决定报哪一条。价格在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)，不在参数页上。

answer.en: Electric 10 Series. Electric 15 does not print a pressure cell.
answer.zh: 电动10系列。电动15不印压力格。

question.en: Is B500S-83D one of these two?

answer.en: No. It is 7.5 kW, 380 V, 280 kg and 5 m / 5 m.

question.en: Are both 380 V on the sheet?
question.zh: 两页都标明 380 V 吗？

answer.en: Neither Electric 10 Series nor Electric 15 prints a voltage cell. Send voltage and frequency yourself.
answer.zh: 电动10系列和电动15都不印电压格。请自行发送电压和频率。
